summary: Regression testing passed for public lessons, seeded admin auth, HttpOnly cookies, refresh rotation, reset/change-password, duplicate quiz replay, authenticated quiz result, progress dashboard, mobile layout, and PWA assets.
action_items: Implement brute-force lockout after five failed login attempts per the authentication contract.
Update the existing seeded admin password/hash when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes, rather than only inserting when absent.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /auth/login has no failed-attempt tracking or lockout despite the required auth playbook contract.
startup seed logic only inserts the admin when missing; it does not reconcile an existing admin's password when configured credentials change.
seed_data_creation: Created uniquely named temporary learner accounts for registration and reset testing; no seeded data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested live API/UI/PWA flows passed, including first/repeated operation_id returning identical JSON-safe quiz payloads. Recheck brute-force lockout and admin seed reconciliation after implementation.
rca of the issue: Auth contract requirements are not represented in server.py: login directly verifies credentials without attempt counters/lockout, and startup only conditionally inserts the configured admin without updating an existing record.
